description: This file defines the 'Connection' interface in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package, representing a connection within the Connectivity service. It includes method signatures for accessing connection properties, lifecycle, and configuration details, as well as nested classes for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: Connection.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions for Connection properties, enabling serialization and deserialization according to JSON schemas.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of this Connection.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns an optional name of the Connection.

methods.name: getConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the type of the connection.

methods.name: getConnectionStatus
methods.description: Returns the current persisted or desired ConnectionStatus.

methods.name: getSources
methods.description: Returns a list of sources for this connection.

methods.name: getTargets
methods.description: Returns a list of targets for this connection.

methods.name: getClientCount
methods.description: Returns the number of clients that should establish the connection, indicating HA mode if greater than 1.

methods.name: isFailoverEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether failover is enabled for this connection.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Returns an optional Credentials object if set.

methods.name: getTrustedCertificates
methods.description: Returns optional trusted certificates in PEM format.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI of the connection.

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol part of the URI.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username part of the URI, if available.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password part of the URI, if available.

methods.name: getHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname part of the URI.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number of the URI.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path part of the URI, if any.

methods.name: isValidateCertificates
methods.description: Indicates if server certificate validation is enforced.

methods.name: getProcessorPoolSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the command processor pool.

methods.name: getSpecificConfig
methods.description: Returns a map of configuration key-value pairs specific to the connection type.

methods.name: getPayloadMappingDefinition
methods.description: Returns the payload mapping definitions for this connection.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns the set of tags associated with the connection.

methods.name: getLifecycle
methods.description: Returns an optional current lifecycle status of the connection.

methods.name: hasLifecycle
methods.description: Checks if the connection has the specified lifecycle.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mutable builder initialized with the current connection's properties.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JSON object representation of the connection, including non-hidden fields.
